g.text: Illustrative model: durability nines are a formula output; parity count dominates, and correlation can erase the gain

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: Illustrative model, not vendor data. MTTDL = mu^m / (n(n-1)...(n-m) lambda^(m+1)); lambda = AFR/8766 h; mu = 1/MTTR; P(loss/yr) = 1 - exp(-G x 8766/MTTDL), G = groups in 10 PB usable on 30 TB

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555
